# opnsense_nginx_limit_zone (Data Source)

nginx limit zones (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Access ▸ Limit Zone**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx limit zone.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `key` (String) Key. One of `binary_remote_addr`.
- `rate` (Number) Rate.
- `rate_unit` (String) Rate Unit. One of `r/s`, `r/m`.
- `size` (Number) Size (MB).
